releases.notes:
The first release of Sign Edit adds an expanded, client-side sign editing experience for Minecraft 26.2 and 26.3.

## Changelog

- Apply bold, italic, underline, strikethrough, and obfuscated formatting to sign text.
- Choose Minecraft sign colors or enter a custom hex color.
- Edit the front and back of signs, and preview different wood types and regular or hanging sign styles.
- Open the editor with `i` by default. Looking at a sign opens it for editing; otherwise, a blank editor opens.
- Configure automatic line breaks and optional looping back to the first line.
- Tested compatibility with BigSignWriter and symbolchat.

## Requirements

Minecraft 26.2 or 26.3, Fabric Loader 0.19.3 or newer, Fabric API, and Java 25 or newer. Mod Menu is optional for in-game settings access.
